**Finding submitted — WARRANTY: deviation (fallback-level cure).**

What I checked:
- **Art. 10 (sec-10-2):** §10.1 mutual reps and §10.2 Harpoon reps are all *as of the Effective Date* and concern corporate authority, patents, know-how, regulatory documentation and debarment — no quality/performance warranty, no duration, no remedy.
- **§10.3/10.4 covenants:** encumbrance, staffing ("Persons with appropriate knowledge, expertise and experience") and IP-assignment covenants only.
- **§10.5 disclaimer (p0557):** disclaims all warranties "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH HEREIN" — so it does not swallow a new express warranty and needs no carve-out edit.
- **Art. 3:** §3.1.2 (Initial Development Activities, breach-notice/step-in) and §3.8.4 ("good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law") are performance covenants, not a warranty with a period and repair/replace/refund remedy.
- Searches for deliverable, conformance, documentation, refund and workmanlike language returned nothing responsive.

Cure: one insert after p0557 adding §10.6 carrying exactly the four fallback elements (90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, repair/replacement, refund). I did not volunteer the preferred 12-month term, malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranties, since the fallback is met by the shorter clause.
